title: Filtering the Goals Listing by Department narrows the list to that department's relevant goals
steps: Navigate to Employee → Goals
Apply the department filter, selecting one department
Observe the Goals Listing
expected: Goals Listing narrows to goals relevant to/assigned within the selected department
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can filter goals based on different departments

title: Clearing the department filter restores the full Goals Listing
steps: Apply a department filter on the Goals Listing
Clear it
expected: Full, unfiltered Goals Listing is restored
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can filter goals based on different departments

title: Add Goal button creates a new goal that appears correctly under the currently selected department filter
steps: Select a specific department filter
Click Add Goal and fill in the mandatory fields
Save
expected: New goal appears in the Goals Listing for the currently selected department, with correct initial (zero) assignment counts
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can add or create goals using add goal button

title: Editing an existing goal only allows changing Certificate Code or Description — other fields are locked
steps: Open the Edit panel for an existing goal
Enumerate every field shown and record its enabled/disabled state
expected: Only Certificate Code and Description are editable; Goal Name, Goal Type, and any other originally-set fields are disabled/read-only
automationHint: This is a newly reported constraint (2026-08-19) not previously captured in employee-details/goals.json — worth persisting to the Goals KB file once confirmed live.
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): once goal is made we can only edit certificate code or description from edit button

title: Attempting to modify a locked field (e.g. Goal Name/Type) on an existing goal is rejected
steps: Open the Edit panel for an existing goal
Attempt to interact with a locked field (e.g. Goal Name)
expected: Field is disabled and cannot be changed through the UI; no write attempt reaches the API for this field
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): once goal is made we can only edit certificate code or description from edit button

title: Editing Certificate Code on an existing goal persists and reflects immediately in the listing
steps: Open the Edit panel for a Certificate-type goal
Change the Certificate Code
Save
expected: New Certificate Code is saved and shown in the listing/detail view without a page reload
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): once goal is made we can only edit certificate code or description from edit button

title: Editing Description on an existing goal persists and reflects immediately
steps: Open the Edit panel for an existing goal
Change the Description
Save
expected: New Description is saved and shown without a page reload
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): once goal is made we can only edit certificate code or description from edit button

title: Editing Certificate Code to an empty value on a Certificate-type goal is rejected
steps: Open the Edit panel for a Certificate-type goal
Clear the Certificate Code field
Attempt to save
expected: Validation error is shown; empty Certificate Code is not persisted for a Certificate-type goal
requirementRef: Regression: validation (required field on Certificate-type goal)

title: Assigned-employees list for a goal is scoped to the currently selected department filter
steps: Select a department filter
Open a goal's assigned-employees list
expected: Only employees belonging to the currently selected department are listed for this goal
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can see assigned employees to this goal in the department we have selected

title: Switching the department filter while viewing a goal's assignees updates the list to the newly selected department
steps: Open a goal's assigned-employees list while Department A is selected
Switch the filter to Department B
Re-check the assigned-employees list
expected: List updates to show only Department B's assignees for that goal, without a page reload
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): we can see assigned employees to this goal in the department we have selected

title: Organization-level assigned-employee count column shows the total across all departments, independent of the current filter
steps: Note the organization-level count column for a goal with no department filter applied
Apply a department filter that narrows the department-scoped count
Re-check the organization-level count column
expected: Organization-level count remains the same total regardless of the department filter; only the department-scoped count changes
requirementRef: Manual requirement (2026-08-19): another column shows number of employees in the goal in the organizational level

title: Department-assigned and organization-assigned counts reconcile with the underlying API totals
steps: Read the department-assigned and organization-assigned counts for a goal from the UI
Fetch the corresponding goal API endpoint
Compare all three values
expected: UI department count, UI organization count, and API totals all match exactly
automationHint: NOTE: underlying rule is speculative — verify with a human before treating a failure as a confirmed regression.
requirementRef: KB-direct: goals.json businessRules — employee-count reconciliation across surfaces
